The chapter heading is printed with a stray space in the word your; the dossier uses the correct word and the content is unaffected [A01].
Commercial license disqualification is only referenced and points to a separate commercial manual; the dossier records the reference only [A03].
The driving record web address is isolated as a dynamic fact in part C.
No figure on these pages comes from outside the manual.
